Card Q&A.a: Tokens are special cards that some effects put into play to represent Digimon or Tamers. This card's effect, for example, plays a token that's treated as a Digimon named [Diaboromon]. For a more detailed explanation of how tokens work, check the official rule manual.

Effect: [Start of Your Turn] If you have a Digimon card with the [Unidentified] trait in your trash, gain 1 memory.

[Your Turn] When any of your Digimon digivolve into [Diaboromon], by suspending this Tamer, play 1 [Diaboromon] Token without paying the cost.  (Digimon/Cost 14/Lv. 6/White/Mega/Unknown/Unidentified/3000 DP)
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
